question: What is the percentage of registered pregnancies that completed at least four antenatal checkups, by district for 2021 to 2023?

insights.message: This data shows coverage levels but cannot explain why some districts have higher or lower rates than others.

view.title: ANC4 Coverage by District (2021–2023)
view.note: Each line shows how the share of registered pregnancies completing four or more antenatal visits changed over 2021 to 2023 for one district. Use the year selector to focus on a single year and compare districts side by side.

interpretation_guard.caveat: Coverage differences between districts may reflect access, staffing, or reporting practices, but this dataset does not contain the information needed to determine the cause.
